Name: Siasz's Demetrius Portraits
Author: Siasz
Description: Demetrius is now complete! I had a harder time with figuring out the right type of smile for him and surprised face, if you have any suggestions let me know! Who would you like to see next?

Downloads.Description: Download the file, go into the zipped folder, copy and paste the image into the portraiture mod where your other images are, if it asks to replace any existing images, click yes.
